cases.counterfactual_axis: Same lexemes and units, but aggregate-quarter versus per-month basis; not a mere change of figures.
cases.deliberate_ambiguity: The year of January through March is not supplied. Publication year must not be substituted for it.

cases.old: The monetary amount covers the three months combined, not an individual month.
cases.new: The monetary amount applies to each individual month, not the three months combined.

cases.counterfactual_axis: Recognizable survey author used as background versus a joint tenant with a rent obligation.
cases.originality_note: Cadastral attribution versus joint tenancy, avoiding platform-owner aliases, benchmark mentions and acquisition cameos.
cases.old: Helqorin is identified solely as the author of the old boundary survey; it is neither a tenant nor a guarantor under this lease.
cases.new: Helqorin is identified as a joint tenant responsible for rent alongside Duzqarel, rather than merely the author of the old boundary survey.

cases.counterfactual_axis: Qosdelun is a financial guarantor versus an incidental circular distributor with no reimbursement obligation.
cases.originality_note: Warranty indemnification allocation rather than purchase, supply agreement or buyer/target inversion.
cases.old: Qosdelun guarantees half of the approved reimbursements under the signed indemnity, while Pluvarek bears the other half.
cases.new: Qosdelun only forwarded the circular through a public mailing list and undertakes no reimbursement obligation; Pluvarek bears every approved claim.

cases.counterfactual_axis: Physical operational handover versus completion of an administrative step only.
cases.originality_note: Custody and operating concession with an administrative seal; no purchase, merger or closure of a due-diligence review.
cases.old: With custody of the kiln and the operating keys now handed to Emzquorin, the cooperative has assumed day-to-day operation.
cases.new: Only the paperwork has been sealed: custody of the kiln and its operating keys remains with Zhulvane until a separate handover.

cases.counterfactual_axis: Current exclusive input dependency versus an obsolete sampling relationship, not a measured loss in either variant.
cases.originality_note: Upstream physical interruption and current versus obsolete input exposure; not parent ownership, franchise status or competitor repricing.
cases.old: Oqzarin currently obtains all pigment for its sole coating line from Truxevan and has no substitute supplier qualified for that line.
cases.new: Oqzarin bought laboratory samples from Truxevan years ago but now obtains the line's pigment from a separate source and has no open Truxevan orders.

cases.counterfactual_axis: Undefined status code versus an explicit operational definition of that same code.
cases.deliberate_ambiguity: Variant a deliberately leaves the event stage unspecified; the actor and refit remain identifiable. No global ambiguity is implied.
cases.originality_note: An opaque industrial tracker plus an explicit glossary, not a morphological substitution of an acquisition verb.
cases.old: The accompanying note does not define R7 or describe which work has occurred.
cases.new: The accompanying glossary defines R7 as physical commissioning accepted by the plant engineer, with the refitted line released for operation.
